facts.effectiveTrustSourceStatement: 未配置请求级 CA，有效信任来源未核实
facts.priorIncorrectClaim: Prior packaging asserted default trust was Node bundled Mozilla CA store merely because no ca option was passed; that inference is not proven by absence of request-level ca alone.

mapBodyTooLargeNullAlignment.explanation: defaultTransport destroys the response and rejects with Error(body_too_large) mid-stream when accumulated bytes exceed maxBytes, before resolve({status, body}). Therefore the forensic ledger correctly records error=body_too_large with httpStatus/bytes/wireSha256 null. Public summary null fields describe those unresolved response metrics for the same failure, not a different outcome. Private transportError.message and public error.message are the same body_too_large event; any code:null vs code:body_too_large difference is packaging-field normalization only.
